title: A Companion to Steadfast Resolve
summary: A companion for those past the courses that turns a plain firm stance into a standing mantle of will and a charge that does not stop.

title: The Blazing Resolve Treatise
summary: A treatise on a will that gathers heat from the fight itself and grows more dangerous with every blow taken.

title: Treatise on the Unbroken Field
summary: A treatise on spreading the will beyond the body as a living field that holds nearby allies upright through a hard fight.

title: The Skysworn Steadfast Canon
summary: A canon of the cultivation-side order on standing fast in the line and lending the line its own calm.

title: Manual of the Sapphire Vow
summary: A manual of a sworn resolve held as a clear blue point of will that does not waver and draws the wavering to it.

title: The High Ascent Resolve Treatise
summary: A treatise on climbing past the point where a body wants to stop and bringing a faltering ally up the same slope.

title: The Wind-Sworn Endurance Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of long endurance in which the sworn student outlasts the gale of a fight and lifts others who bend before it.

title: The Oathbound Standing Book
summary: A book of standing by a sworn word while the field of the will carries that word to every ally in reach.

title: The Gale-Tempered Fortitude Compendium
summary: A compendium of fortitude beaten out by long storms that turns a hard blow into fuel and calls a failing ally back from the brink.
